P1.2.text: Leader in the Specialty Property and Casualty Marketplace

P1.3.text: American Financial Group is committed to delivering financial solutions that fulfill today’s needs and tomorrow’s dreams. Our Specialty P&C Insurance Group offers specialized commercial products that help businesses manage financial risk with insurance products that meet their specific and ever-changing financial risk exposures.

P1.4.text: Our insurance operations are members of Great American Insurance Group, whose history dates back to 1872, with the founding of Great American Insurance Company.

P1.5.text: A Specialist in Property and Casualty Insurance

P1.6.text: Our Specialty P&C Insurance Group offers specialized commercial products that help businesses manage financial risk with insurance products that meet their specific and ever-changing financial risk exposures.

P1.8.text: View All News View All Events

P1.9.text: American Financial Group, Inc. Announces Closing of the Sale of Charleston Harbor Resort & Marina

P1.12.text: Because you are buying a promise, you want to know that the insurance company you choose is financially strong. One way to judge this is by the ratings assigned by outside rating agencies.

P2.1.text: About Us | American Financial Group, Inc.

P2.2.text: American Financial Group, Inc. is a holding company based in Cincinnati, Ohio and. Our insurance roots go back to 1872 with the founding of Great American Insurance Company. Today, through the operations of Great American Insurance Group, AFG is engaged in property and casualty (P&C) insurance, focusing on specialized commercial products for businesses. We are proud to provide insurance products that help businesses manage their unique financial risks and exposures.

P2.3.text: AFG’s Specialty P&C Group is comprised of over 35 diversified businesses offering a wide range of specialty commercial coverages in three major groupings: Property and Transportation, Specialty Casualty and Specialty Financial.

P2.4.text: Many of our businesses are among the top performers in their respective industries. Our business has entrepreneurial spirit at its core, with a focus on accountability. Business autonomy in our Specialty P&C operations facilitates agility in underwriting, claims and policy servicing, and enables these businesses to develop distribution strategies and relationships in the unique markets they serve.

P2.5.text: By following a consistent, opportunistic strategy over many years and changing economic conditions, we have outperformed market indices over the long term while effectively managing portfolio risk.

P2.6.text: With the power of generations behind it, AFG grows and changes with discipline and integrity. We're proud of who we are, where we've been and where we're going. Our industry is changing, and we continue to change as well.

P2.7.text: American Financial Group traces its history to 1959. In the early days, the Company was known as American Financial Corporation. At its inception, the Company’s principal business consisted of savings and loans. Although insurance and financial services have always been at the core of its businesses, nearly sixty-five years later, the Company has evolved into a holding company with over 35 market-leading insurance operations engaged in the sale of specialty commercial property and casualty (P&C) insurance across a variety of industries.

P2.8.text: Over the past 20 or so years, we have sharpened our focus on the businesses we know best. We’ve done this through carefully selected acquisitions, start-ups, and dispositions of non-core businesses. A sampling of transactions appears below:

P2.11.text: Acquired all minority shares of Great American Financial Resources, Inc.

P2.13.text: Sale of Medicare supplement & critical illness businesses

P2.16.text: Start-up of Great American's Singapore branch

P2.18.text: Start-up of El Aguila Specialty P&C Division

P1.1.text: Boston Omaha Corporation — Diversified Public Holding Company

P1.2.text: Boston Omaha Corporation, is a public holding company with four businesses: Broadband, Billboards, Bonds and Boston Omaha Asset Management.

P1.3.text: Boston Omaha Corporation, is a public holding company with four businesses: Broadband (telecommunications services), Billboards (outdoor advertising), Bonds (surety insurance) and Asset Management.

P2.2.text: Challenging the Way We Look at the Insurance Business

P2.3.text: General Indemnity Group (GIG) is an insurance holding company. The company specializes in acquiring and operating companies that underwrite and distribute insurance products.

P2.4.text: The innovative GIG team grows businesses by building digital, online offerings and modernizing outdated systems and workflows. They transform paper processes and methods of the past into more efficient digital and automated routines. Their expertise in data visualization, systems engineering, software design, product management, IT and HR is exceptional.

P2.5.text: Since its incorporation in, GIG has acquired five surety-only agencies, as well as an A- Excellent” (AM Best rating) monoline surety insurance company., United Casualty and Surety. United Casualty & Surety is licensed to write surety policies in all 50 states, and is approved by the United States Department of the Treasury (Dept. Circular 570) to bond federal projects throughout the United States.

P3.2.text: Boston Omaha Broadband (BOB) is a regional broadband provider specializing in fiber internet deployment within the markets served by our multiple operating subsidiaries.

P3.3.text: The BOB Internet Service Provider Companies

P3.4.text: Built on a Dream to Provide the Internet to the Underserved

P3.5.text: AireBeam is one of Arizona’s fastest growing fiber-to-home and fixed wireless internet service providers. The company successfully delivers affordable, accessible internet access and innovative solutions to rural communities across state.

P3.6.text: AireBeam was born from a need the company founders observed. Rural Arizona residents themselves, they noted a lack of access to reliable internet service in the area. In fact, most of the population couldn’t even handle small, day-to-day tasks via the internet.

P3.7.text: AireBeam is now a determined force for change in their local communities. They believe everyone should have access to fast, reliable internet service, especially the underserved.

P3.9.text: This alliance allows them to plan for additional Fiber-to-Home projects and expand services to not only consumers, but also to home builders, developers, build-to-rent communities, RV parks and others.

P3.10.text: Fiber-Fast Internet for New Homes and Build-to-Rent Communities

P3.11.text: Fiber Fast Homes, a Fiber-to-the-Home internet service company, delivers new home communities and build-to-rent communities with reliable, high-speed fiber internet services at Gig speeds.

P3.12.text: Today, new home buyers expect fast internet service that can handle the high-bandwidth demands of their smart homes, smart phones, home offices, communication and entertainment needs. Fiber Fast Homes manages that with their best-in-class technology and an elevated level of customer support.

P3.13.text: The company partners with builders, developers and build-to-rent communities to build fiber-to-the-home infrastructure and internet service, and provides concierge customer service to residents.

P3.15.text: Southern Utah’s First Internet Company and Still a Leader in Innovative Internet Service

P3.16.text: InfoWest specializes in providing reliable, cost-effective, high-speed home and business internet connections. the company has accrued the expertise and experience to connect their customers in remote locations with exceptional broadband service utilizing the latest in wireless technologies.

P3.17.text: InfoWest provides wireless broadband and fiber-optic internet services to residents and businesses throughout Utah, as well as select areas of Nevada, Arizona and Colorado. The company also delivers VoIP, TV, security and surveillance, IoT automation, personalized streaming services and a range of small business offerings.

P3.18.text: Consistently Ranked One of Utah’s Most-Trusted High-Speed Internet Providers

P3.19.text: Utah Broadband delivers broadband fiber and fixed wireless internet service to several counties throughout the front and back
